Blocker is a missing demonstrated protected architecture, not now-missing native permission. Blind automatic retry will not resolve it: retryable=false. Orchestrator owns a concrete architecture/scope decision and normal replan; do not weaken unrestricted desktop scope, count simulated input as human provenance or hand unresolved security design to downstream workers.
